module: StackTracePlus: third-party library (Ignacio Burgueño, MIT license) that produces detailed Lua stack traces: guessed function names when they are missing, known functions and tables of the standard library, and a dump of the local variables of each level. Usable as an error handler for xpcall or pcall. The module returns the table _M.
usage:
local stp = require("libs/StackTracePlus/StackTracePlus")
local ok, trace = xpcall(myFunction, function(e) return (stp.stacktrace(e)) end)
notes: stacktrace and stacktraceSimple accept an optional first thread argument: if it is not of type thread, the parameters are shifted (message, level, level_limit, dump_locals).
dump_locals is true by default. level is 1 by default and level_limit stops the climb.
stacktrace returns two values: the trace (string) and the original error (string or rendering of a table error object).
add_known_table and add_known_function raise an error if the item is already known to the module ("Cannot override...").

stacktrace.desc: Collects a detailed stack trace (delimited by "Stack Traceback >> START/END"), with the local variables of each Lua level. Suited as an xpcall error handler.

thread.desc: Coroutine to inspect (default: the current coroutine)

message.desc: Error message or object placed at the head of the trace

stacktraceSimple.desc: Variant of stacktrace with the same parameters, producing a simpler trace (inferred from code: same skeleton, without the same detailed formatting).

add_known_table.desc: Adds a table to the list of known tables, with a description used when displaying local variables.

add_known_function.desc: Adds a function to the list of known functions, with a description used in the traces.

Dumper.desc: Internal object that analyzes a stack (created by Dumper.new(thread)) and accumulates the trace lines.

new.desc: Creates a Dumper bound to a coroutine; adapts getinfo/getlocal (one-level offset if it is the current coroutine).

add.desc: Adds a line of text to the buffer.

concat_lines.desc: Concatenates the accumulated lines into a string.

DumpLocals.desc: Walks through and adds to the trace the local variables of a stack level.
